steps.domain_action: Initialize the real number field R
Invoke the Axiom of Choice to permit transfinite selection
Construct a set A with cardinality 2^ℵ₀
Define the internal structure of A to ensure linear independence over Q
Perform Minkowski addition to generate the set A + A
Evaluate the membership of A + A elements against the sum-free set S
Confirm that no element of A + A is contained within S
Verify that for every s in S, no pair a1, a2 in A exists such that a1 + a2 = s
Reject any candidate set A that produces a sum falling within S
Reconstitute the total sum-set space for final validation
Fix the definition of A as a valid solution to the domain constraints
Seal the construction within the topology of R
